name: Unstoppable Slasher
clause: When ~ dies, if it had no counters on it, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control with two stun counters on it.

needs.proposedSignature: { kind: 'self-no-counters'; counter: 'any' } (and the same for self-had-counters)
needs.semantics: True when the object has (had) no counters of ANY kind on it, rather than none of one named kind.
needs.clause: if it had no counters on it
